name: Solaarchy
author: C50NK4
description: Every connected Logitech device at a glance in the Omarchy bar: battery per device, live connect and disconnect, low-battery alerts and the keyboard backlight, read through Solaar.

barWidget.description: Battery and backlight for your Logitech devices at a glance, via Solaar. Left-click: panel. Right-click: keyboard backlight. Middle-click: open Solaar.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: solaar, or a device icon: mouse, keyboard, combo, each also as -outline. To use your own artwork instead, see customIcon.

schema.label: Custom bar icon
schema.description: File name of an SVG in the custom icon folder, without the .svg (for example: my-logo). Overrides the bar icon above while set. Solaarchy ships no vendor logos, so this is how you use your own.

schema.label: Custom icon folder
schema.description: Folder scanned for custom bar icons. Defaults to ~/.config/omarchy/solaarchy/icons.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Backup poll. Connects, disconnects and receiver plugging update right away; each poll wakes the receiver, so keep this relaxed.

schema.label: Low battery threshold (%)
schema.description: Below this the icon turns urgent and one notification is sent per discharge.

schema.label: Hide when no receiver
schema.description: Hide the widget while no Logitech receiver or device is connected. It reappears when one is plugged in.
